ai.title: Are LLM Assistants Regulatory Ready? Answers from regenold's 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.04546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly proposed for regulatory affairs, yet their reliability in regulatory tasks remains unclear. We introduce the EU AI Act Q&A Benchmark, an expert-curated benchmark of 110 open-ended questions about the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Each question comes with an exemplary answer, question-specific correctness criteria, and expected references. Evaluation measures answer correctness, reference quality, conciseness, tone, and latency, with a multi-turn ``hard mode'' testing responses to simulated user pushback. We also present the results of the 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge, based on the benchmark, where three off-the-shelf baselines and five purpose-built assistants (from four commercial developers and one academic entrant) were tested. Only two of the five submitted assistants consistently outperformed the baselines; one achieved high scores across all evaluated metrics. These results show that specialist development alone does not guarantee better performance and highlight the critical importance of LLM assistant evaluation in regulatory affairs. The benchmark code is openly available at https://github.com/regenold-GmbH/eu-ai-act-benchmark-2026/.
ai.summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly proposed for regulatory affairs, yet their reliability in regulatory tasks remains unclear.

ai.title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.03698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. ai.title: FP4Quant: Efficient 4-Bit Communication Compression for Model-Parallel LLM Training
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.04323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made communication overhead a critical bottleneck in distributed model-parallel training. Although existing low-precision compression methods can effectively reduce communication costs, further reducing the communication footprint to ultra-low-bit formats such as FP4 introduces new challenges, including limited numerical range, sub-byte storage overhead, and increased computational cost from fine-grained quantization. In this paper, we present \textbf{FP4Quant}, a micro-grouped FP4 compression framework for efficient model-parallel LLM training. FP4Quant integrates a micro-grouped dual-scale FP4 quantization mechanism to preserve local tensor distribution characteristics, a warp-cooperative FP4 packing scheme to enable efficient sub-byte data representation, and a hybrid two-level FWHT pipeline to mitigate quantization errors with GPU-aware execution optimization. Experiments on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Qwen-7B demonstrate up to 1.56$\times$ end-to-end throughput improvement over BF16, revealing a trade-off between throughput and model quality.
ai.summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made communication overhead a critical bottleneck in distributed model-parallel training.

ai.title: Whose startup does the AI back? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in LLM-assisted crowdfunding
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.03993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support. LLMs have known race and gender problems, and it is unsettled whether they reproduce, erase, or reverse the discrimination documented in entrepreneurial finance. We ask when, and through which decision process, LLM assistants use founders' gender and ethnicity. In a pre-specified choice-based conjoint experiment, seven LLMs chose among five synthetic campaigns with independently randomized quality signals and founder names, under three backer personas and a persona-free control (40,248 responses). By default, founder names barely matter: under budget-conscious and delivery-focused personas, gender and Black-name effects are statistically equivalent to zero. When the backer wants to support underrepresented creators, the models favor Black-signaled (+8.1 percentage points; positive in all seven models) and female-signaled (+5.1) founders. They do so most strongly among near-tied campaigns and for the founder who alone carries the signal, and they almost never name gender or ethnicity in their reasons. The results fit an agency account of algorithmic discrimination: an aligned assistant takes its demographic preferences from its user rather than from its training data.
ai.summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support.

ai.title: Evaluating LLMs as Judges of Counterspeech Quality Against Online Hate Speech
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.04627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prolonged exposure to hate speech on social media can cause lasting psychological distress among users. Counterspeech has emerged as an effective, non-censorial mitigation strategy, but its deployment requires rigorous quality assessment. Manual assessment is unscalable due to the large volume of content on the Web and imposes severe emotional strain on human annotators. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative, yet concerns remain regarding their reliability. In this paper, we investigate the extent to which LLMs can effectively perform this task. We test 12 open-weight LLMs of different sizes and families under zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting, to approximate pointwise and pairwise human expert assessment of counterspeech quality across four dimensions: relevance, coherence, aggressiveness, and suitableness. We find that (i) LLMs show low agreement and moderate rank correlations with human experts: our best configuration, Qwen 2.5 72B on coherence, achieves up to a linear-weighted Cohen's $\kappa_l = 0.19$ and Spearman's $\rho = 0.42$ in pointwise evaluation and an unweighted Cohen's $\kappa = 0.25$ in pairwise evaluation. (ii) Converting pointwise scores into pairwise labels substantially improves human--LLM agreement for selected configurations. For same-instance coherence, Qwen 2.5 72B under zero-shot prompting achieves $\kappa = 0.35$ with converted labels, compared with $\kappa = 0.25$
ai.summary: Prolonged exposure to hate speech on social media can cause lasting psychological distress among users.

ai.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.05287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. trade.raw_summary: 「雙11」購物季是跨境網購的大旺季，財政部關務署提醒民眾切勿錯認「網站買得到就能合法進口」！倘若商品屬於輸入管制貨品，必須取得貨品主管機關許可文件才能進口，海關呼籲民眾跨境網購前務必先確認貨品是否涉及輸入規定，否則可能因違規而受罰。 財政部關務署表示，跨境網購商品種類繁多，常見如應施檢疫之動植物產品（如肉乾、種子）、醫療器材及藥品（如輪椅、玻尿酸）、電信管制射頻器材（如無線耳機）、應施檢驗商品（如玩具、行動電源）及管制輸入大陸物品（如螺螄粉、花生）等，進口時均應分別遵守農業部動植物防疫檢疫署、衛生福利部食品藥物管理署、國家通訊傳播委員會、經濟部標準檢驗局及經濟部國際貿易署等貨品主管機關的輸入規定辦理。因相關規定分散於不同主管機關，民眾往往不清楚哪些商品需要事先申請許可，一不小心就可能觸法。 該署說明，為提醒跨境網購民眾留意貨品輸入規定，已依立法院林委員岱樺質詢建議，彙整各貨品主管機關提供常見涉及輸入規定貨品資料，請關貿網路股份有限公司於「EZ Way 易利委」APP首頁及預先委任畫面，今年11月3日前建置「網購貨物常見涉輸入規定查詢參考」功能。民眾只需輸入貨品關鍵字，就能查詢相關輸入規定、主管機關聯絡資訊及注意事項；為使民眾更容易理解，再以顏色區分，其中，紅色代表禁止輸入或須事先取得輸入許可、黃色則代表限量內可免申請輸入許可，超過限量就須事先申請，讓民眾一目了然。 關務署進一步表示，為滿足民眾查詢其他商品的需求，透過EZ Way APP「AI貨品稅則查詢」連結至該署「貨品歸屬稅則查詢系統」，方便查詢貨品稅則稅率、輸入規定及主管機關等詳細資訊。除了透過EZ Way APP查詢，民眾亦可利用關港貿單一窗口「(GC473)貨品輸出入查詢」網頁查詢貨品輸出入規定，該網頁以貨品類型分類（如食品、藥品、農產品等），提供民眾更全面查詢貨品輸出入相關規定的服務。 關務署最後提醒，「網購先查清，收貨更安心！」跨境網購除了比價格、看評價，更要確認商品能不能合法進口。尤其同一貨物可能涉及多個貨品主管機關輸入規定，必須全數符合始得進口，民眾如有疑問可先洽詢貨品主管機關，避免因不諳法規而導致貨物延遲通關，甚至面臨貨物退運或遭裁罰等情形。該署呼籲切勿聽信境外劣質業者不實廣告，唯有事前查明規定、誠實申報，方可享受便捷安全之通關服務。 新聞稿聯絡人：陳科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2521

trade.title: 把握裁處核定前減罰措施，行政救濟權益不影響
trade.raw_summary: 基隆關表示，商民於通關過程中，偶因不諳法規或作業疏失而涉及違反海關緝私條例及相關稅法規定，依據「緝私案件裁罰金額或倍數參考表」及「稅務違章案件裁罰金額或倍數參考表」（下均稱「裁倍表」）規定，若能在海關裁罰處分核定前，補繳稅款或同意以足額保證金抵繳，可適用較有利的裁罰倍數，享合法減罰的機會。 基隆關說明，進口貨物經查有虛報且短漏進口稅捐，而涉海關緝私條例、加值型及非加值型營業稅法、貨物稅條例、菸酒稅法或特種貨物及勞務稅條例等違章案件，海關須參考前揭「裁倍表」進行裁處。法規設計初衷，是為鼓勵受處分人積極履行稅款繳納義務，並提高稽徵行政效益，對於補繳稅款受處分人，予以實質減罰效果。 基隆關進一步說明，為讓商民更清楚減罰帶來的實質效益，以進口貨物逃漏稅案件為例：如商民因虛報進口貨物價值，逃漏關稅新臺幣（下同）100萬元及營業稅20萬元，依「裁倍表」應處所漏關稅額3倍罰鍰300萬元及所漏營業稅額1.5倍罰鍰30萬元，但受處分人於裁罰處分核定前，已補繳上開所漏稅款或同意以足額保證金抵繳，因符合裁倍表所列減罰要件，可處所漏關稅額2.5倍罰鍰250萬元及所漏營業稅額0.75倍罰鍰15萬元。 基隆關提醒，部分商民誤以為簽署「減輕裁罰倍數同意書」等同放棄救濟權利，事實上，受處分人申請復查權利不因辦理減輕裁罰手續而喪失，亦不影響後續提起訴願及行政訴訟權益。因此，誠摯呼籲商民，於海關通知時務必留意辦理期限，主動補繳稅款或繳回「減輕裁罰倍數同意書」，並同意以已繳納足額保證金抵繳稅款，讓海關能依法幫您省下罰鍰支出。若對申辦流程、應備文件或法規適用有任何疑問，歡迎隨時撥打諮詢專線，由專人為您提供輔導與協助。 聯絡人：法務緝案組陳稽核琪瓏 電話：（02）2420-2951 分機3203

Unless the Department of Commerce ("Commerce") extends the time for initiation, the Commission must reach a preliminary determination in antidumping and countervailing duty investigations in 45 days, or in this case by December 14, 2026. The Commission's views must be transmitted to Commerce within five business days thereafter, or by December 21, 2026.

trade.title: Certain Extrusion-Coated Magnet Wire; Notice of Institution of Investigation
trade.raw_summary: Notice is hereby given that a complaint was filed with the U.S. International Trade Commission on September 29, 2026, under section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, on behalf of Essex Solutions Inc. of Atlanta, Georgia and Essex Solutions USA LLC of Atlanta, Georgia. A supplement was filed on October 13, 2026. The complaint, as supplemented, alleges violations of section 337 based upon the importation into the United States, the sale for importation, and the sale within the United States after importation of certain extrusion-coated magnet wire by reason of the infringement of certain claims of U.S. Patent No. 8,847,075 ("the '075 patent"), U.S. Patent No. 9,224,523 ("the '523 patent"), and U.S. Patent No. 10,210,966 ("the '966 patent"). The complaint further alleges that an industry in the United States exists or is in the process of being established as required by the applicable Federal Statute. The complainants request that the Commission institute an investigation and, after the investigation, issue a limited exclusion order and cease and desist orders.

world.raw_summary: 俄罗斯借助由老旧油轮组成的"影子舰队"规避西方制裁。据报道，特朗普政府正考虑解除部分影子舰队油轮的制裁，以缓解创纪录的运费。专家警告，此举将削弱对俄制裁、帮助莫斯科获得收入，并使美欧在战略上分道扬镳。欧盟虽握有航运和保险等工具，但若没有美国支持，执法将更加艰难。
